dependencies.runtimeBehavior: Exact-pinned Swift/Core ML runtime. The recorded binary size/digest describe the original external ASR/SpeakerKit smoke only. The same source revision is also linked solely into the developer AlphaASREvalCLI for the large-v3-turbo quality comparison; the main App does not depend on WhisperKit. Source/model/tokenizer acquisition is explicit, local tokenizers are parsed before loading, automatic model download is disabled, and evaluation runs under a deny-all network sandbox. SwiftPM resolves swift-argument-parser 1.8.2 (6a52f3251125d74daf04fcbd5e6f08a75d074382), Apache-2.0 with Swift Runtime Library Exception, Swift tools 6.0 and no declared package OS minimum. That package is required only by upstream CLI targets and is neither compiled into this evaluator nor linked into the App; its source acquisition is developer-only.
dependencies.distributionImpact: Evaluation binaries, models, tokenizer, and downloaded package sources remain outside the repository and release package. Only the evaluation CLI imports WhisperKit/ArgmaxCore; no Whisper runtime dependency has been selected for App shipping, and SpeakerKit model licensing remains unresolved.
